# Kalen Young — Frontend Developer

> Angular & TypeScript frontend developer available for freelance and remote work. Production experience at COHO (UK proptech). Dual UK / South African citizen based in Durban.

## About

Kalen Young is a frontend developer specialising in Angular and TypeScript. He holds dual UK and South African citizenship and works remotely with UK-based teams. His production experience includes shipping code into the live codebase at COHO, a UK property technology company. He has been delivering client projects since 2023.

## Stack

- Angular, TypeScript, React
- Supabase, PostgreSQL
- Astro, Tailwind CSS
- C# / .NET
- Git, Vercel, Playwright

## Projects

- [Propza](https://kalenyoung.co.uk/projects/propza/) — Angular + Supabase property-management SaaS. Auth flows, domain data, operator-grade form handling and empty states.
- [Personal Budget Tracker](https://kalenyoung.co.uk/projects/personal-budget-tracker/) — Full-stack budget tracking application.
- [Simon Clark Fitness](https://kalenyoung.co.uk/projects/simon-clark-fitness/) — Astro marketing site for a personal trainer. Delivered on time, live in production at simonclarkfitness.co.uk.
